title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 2c12964e25ea… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 2c12964e25ea73ec4ae6be6b6f4b89cf5280c0dafc3ae6112bf2b8e1a97c2943 was observed three times on November 16, 2026, by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. The file is associated with attacker activity involving the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer). The malicious payload could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. The attacker infrastructure was located in the Netherlands. Organizations are advised to match this hash against their files and security telemetry to detect potential compromise.
